references.text: Parallels are drawn between Noah's time and the events leading to the flood, and the unexpected events of the end times.
The suddenness of the Lord's day, which comes like a thief, resembles the unexpected nature of the events described in Matthew 24:40.
The rapture of believers to meet the Lord in the air has similarities with one being taken and the other left behind.
Enoch was taken away by God, which can be seen as a precursor to the one who is taken away in Matthew 24:40.
